about: The home page, as one Task Object, following the AgoraHome board of November 1, 2026, light only: Start here with the two public sites, Open Eranos and the 45-second tour for judges in the first screen, then the decks, then the use cases, which link to Use cases and Models used. The use-case strip shows the use-cases page's own cards once that page holds them. The film is withdrawn until its re-recorded cut lands, so the page has no film slot. scripts/build_site.py renders it into site/index.html. The film's production page is linked only once its production trace is final (film_made).
title: Agora, the ta-amps overview
description: Agora is the ta-amps overview: where to start, the decks and the use cases. The use case is Eranos, spare tokens for good. Underneath, all work is Tasks, and everything a task uses or makes is a Task Object.
